title: Gemini moves to 2.5 Pro Experimental
summary:
Gemini got a new model behind its familiar name, text models gained aliases, and responses lost an unwanted extra.

The `gemini` text model now maps to Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental via Vertex AI, replacing Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview.

Text model lookup now accepts defined aliases as well as primary names. The included demo maps `gpt4` to `openai-large`; DeepSeek reasoning mappings and persona model configurations were also updated.

The text server no longer adds NSFW referral links to generated responses. `/openai/models` now returns smaller OpenAI-style records with the provider in `owned_by`, while error logging carries more useful diagnostic context.

highlights.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental
highlights.text: The `gemini` text model now points to Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental instead of Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite Preview. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini).

highlights.title: Aliases for text models
highlights.text: Text requests can use defined model aliases as well as primary names. An included demo maps `gpt4` to `openai-large`. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
